Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, thrombocytopenia, leukopenia with monocytosis and basophilia, mild hypoglycemia, elevated ferritin and CRP, and a significantly increased INR. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection or inflammatory process, and impaired coagulation. Clinical correlation and further evaluation for underlying causes (e.g., sepsis, liver dysfunction, hematologic disorder) are recommended.
